text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm training with El Condor Pasa, when…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Agh… My eyes are killin' me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I was watchin' wrestling all night! I was so caught up in it, I didn't realize how late it was! Haha!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But you know what? The wrestlers' combo techniques were insane!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I'm not asleep! My mind just couldn't keep up with my body!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She won't admit it, but she's clearly exhausted from watching those late-night matches.
